note: Demo personas for Supabase Auth (docs/specs/supabase-login-v1.md section 3.4). Customer ids come from the lakehouse sample; emails and passwords never live here.

personas.label: cliente-hasta-150
personas.scenario: A charge of USD 150 or less in the window: the case opens without a human (POL-AUT-150 or POL-AUT-INTAKE).
personas.message: No reconozco un cargo de 113.65 USD del 3 de junio

personas.label: cliente-mas-de-500
personas.scenario: A charge over USD 500: the turn goes to a human (POL-ESC-500) and the console shows the handoff.
personas.message: No reconozco un cargo de 4259.97 USD del 12 de junio

personas.label: cliente-tarjeta-perdida
personas.scenario: A lost card and a charge of USD 500 or less: the case opens and the lock is offered in the same reply (POL-AUT-LOCK); after the yes, the card is locked.
personas.message: Perdí la tarjeta y no reconozco un cargo de 168.88 USD del 9 de junio

personas.label: agente
personas.scenario: The HITL console: the handoff of the over-500 case and the lock appear here.
